state.spec: Rewrite the to_svg(wf) function in the EXISTING module packages/flow/src/flow/graph.py so it renders the workflow with Graphviz auto-layout via the pydot library, satisfying the contract tests test_svg.py and test_svg_doc.py. KEEP _to_svg_fallback and to_ascii, to_mermaid, _condition_label, _edge_ascii, _mermaid_edge, _edge_label and all module constants EXACTLY as they are — only replace the body of to_svg.
